agents.brief: You own dataset expt_gap (regression, MAE eV). Beat the reference baseline (/lab/data/baselines/materials_baseline.py, HistGradientBoosting on Magpie-lite features) on 5-fold CV in train.csv, then publish a prediction-profile finding. Work in your own dir under /work, run everything via lab exec, put metrics in metrics.json, and post results on the board. Share your best feature/model idea with the 'glass' and 'steels' researchers if it transfers.

You own dataset glass (classification, error rate). Beat the baseline error rate on 5-fold CV (baseline: /lab/data/baselines/materials_baseline.py). Try class-balanced models and feature sets. Publish a prediction-profile finding only after lab exec shows a real CV gain. Post your results on the board.

You own expt_is_metal (classification, error rate). Beat the baseline error rate on CV. Note expt_gap is a sister dataset: a band gap of 0 suggests a metal, so consider using expt_gap train data as an auxiliary feature source (copy it in via DATA_DIR). Publish a prediction-profile finding only after lab exec shows a real gain. Post on the board.

You own steels (regression, yield strength MPa, only 237 rows). Beat the baseline CV MAE. Small data: try kernel ridge / GP / ensembles with composition features. Publish a prediction-profile finding only after lab exec shows a real gain. Post on the board.

artifacts.title: ExtraTrees on Magpie-lite + element-fraction features beats Magpie HGB baseline on steel yield-strength CV
artifacts.reason: accepted: hidden MAE: model beats the environment baseline (difference -33.5938, 95% CI [-55.0515, -15.2769], beyond the minimum effect 2.3161)

claim.statement: Repeated 5-fold CV (3 seeds) MAE on steels: ExtraTrees (500 trees, max_features=0.5) on Magpie-lite plus element-fraction features is 90.9 MPa, versus 129.3 MPa for the HistGradientBoosting Magpie-lite baseline (about 30% lower).

artifacts.title: ExtraTrees (max_features=1.0, min_samples_leaf=1) on Magpie-lite + element fractions beats Magpie HGB baseline on fresh-seed steel CV
artifacts.reason: accepted: hidden MAE: model beats the environment baseline (difference -31.5026, 95% CI [-52.6071, -13.2743], beyond the minimum effect 2.3161)

claim.statement: On 5 CV seeds (3-7) not used for tuning, ExtraTrees (500 trees, max_features=1.0, min_samples_leaf=1) on Magpie-lite plus element-fraction features has MAE 91.7 MPa versus 130.9 MPa for the HistGradientBoosting Magpie-lite baseline; paired difference 39.2 MPa (SE 3.4).

artifacts.title: Magpie-extended features with HGB+ExtraTrees ensemble beat the reference baseline on expt_gap
artifacts.reason: accepted: hidden MAE: model beats the environment baseline (difference -0.0350, 95% CI [-0.0518, -0.0179], beyond the minimum effect 0.0083)

claim.statement: On 5-fold CV (KFold shuffle seed 0) over expt_gap train.csv, an equal-weight ensemble of HistGradientBoosting and ExtraTrees on extended Magpie-style features (241 features incl. element fractions and p-norms) reduces CV MAE from 0.476 eV (reference baseline) to 0.423 eV.

artifacts.title: expt_gap: squared-error GBM with std and element-fraction features beats the Magpie-lite baseline in 5-fold CV
artifacts.summary: Same features as materials_baseline.py plus per-compound composition std of element properties, and a sparse element-fraction vector. Model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(squared_error, 800 iters, lr 0.05, 63 leaves, l2=1), 5-fold KFold(seed 0) on train.csv only. Baseline CV MAE 0.4759 eV (exec-a66bd9b2); l1+std+frac CV MAE 0.4494 eV (exec-26d97101). Note: absolute_error loss collapses to a constant 0 prediction on this target (exec-2af46359), so squared error is required.
artifacts.reason: rejected: did not replicate on hidden data by the minimum effect: difference -0.0100, 95% CI [-0.0282, 0.0090], needed below -0.0083

claim.statement: On expt_gap, adding element-property standard deviations and element-fraction features to the baseline featurizer lowers 5-fold CV MAE below the reference baseline's 0.4759 eV.

artifacts.title: Magpie-lite + element-fraction HGB/ExtraTrees average beats Magpie-lite HGB baseline on expt_is_metal CV
artifacts.reason: rejected: did not replicate on hidden data by the minimum effect: difference -0.0040, 95% CI [-0.0089, 0.0008], needed below -0.0016

claim.statement: On expt_is_metal, averaging HistGradientBoosting and ExtraTrees classifiers trained on Magpie-lite statistics plus a 100+-dim element-fraction vector lowers 5-fold CV error from 0.0900 (baseline, paired folds over 3 CV seeds) to 0.0864, better than the baseline in 12 of 15 folds. The expt_gap lookup was not used: its apparent gain (0.0065 CV error) was leakage from held-out labels, and with held-out compositions removed it contributes nothing, since every expt_gap train composition is already in expt_is_metal train.

artifacts.title: Class-balanced HGB+RF+ExtraTrees ensemble on Magpie-lite + element fractions lowers glass-forming classification CV error vs Magpie HGB baseline
artifacts.summary: 3-seed stratified 5-fold CV on glass train.csv. Ensemble mean error 0.1162 vs baseline 0.1203 (diff -0.0041); ensemble lower on every seed (per-seed diffs -0.0014 to -0.0067). Gain is small relative to fold std (~0.01); not a large effect.
artifacts.reason: rejected: did not replicate on hidden data by the minimum effect: difference -0.0086, 95% CI [-0.0179, 0.0013], needed below -0.0022

claim.statement: On glass-forming ability classification, a soft-vote ensemble of class-balanced HGB, RandomForest and ExtraTrees on Magpie-lite plus element-fraction features has lower error rate than the materials_baseline HGB, averaged over 3 stratified 5-fold CV seeds (0.1162 vs 0.1203).

artifacts.title: Replication: gap ensemble CV advantage over baseline holds on fold seeds 1 and 2 (expt_gap)
artifacts.summary: Ran the code of findin-60df457e unchanged except KFold random_state (1 and 2 instead of 0). Paired baseline run (materials_baseline featurizer + HGB, same folds) on seeds 0,1,2 in exec-b8f659da. Ensemble CV MAE: seed1 0.4196 eV (exec-5e435a9f), seed2 0.4232 eV (exec-ddf79c59). Baseline CV MAE: seed1 0.4749 eV, seed2 0.4761 eV (seed0 0.4759 eV). Component CV MAE: HGB 0.434 (seed1) and 0.442 (seed2); ExtraTrees 0.431 (seed1) and 0.427 (seed2). The ensemble beats the baseline on both replicated fold seeds, and the ensemble's seed-to-seed spread (0.0035 eV) is far smaller than the gap to the baseline (about 0.05 eV). artifacts.reason: accepted: hidden MAE: model beats the environment baseline (difference -0.0983, 95% CI [-0.1328, -0.0653], beyond the minimum effect 0.0083)
